decisions.statement: A property's target is read from the index rather than from the pages.
A page's key reaches the property stating that key rather than the property its slug camelises to.
A key one property carries reaches that property.
A page's own type is asked only where a key is carried by more than one property.
A field reaches only a property the record the field stands in declares.
One key carried by two properties reaches each property under the type with that property.
A key carried by two properties reaches nothing where a page's type has neither property.
A name saying its own page type is held to the target its property declares.
A name saying a scope reaches the page filed under that scope.
Which property scopes a page type is read from that page type's declarations.
A name becomes an address of one page address kind before the index is asked.
A value that narrows to more than one page is refused rather than resolved to a single page.
A property naming members is held to the target every member declares.
A property naming members has every field those members declare.
A property declaring fields of its own takes none from its members.
A value the index cannot resolve is reported rather than thrown.
A page naming the same page twice files one edge.
A name nested in a record is filed from the page carrying the name rather than from the record.
The page a name reaches is said here alone.
A name that reaches a page answers where that page sits beside its id.
Whether a page type is mortal is answered beside the page a name reaches.
A name stating a page type is judged mortal by that page type alone.
A name stating no page type is judged by every target its property declares.
Which property each key of a page carries is read here.
The value standing under that key is answered with that property.
A page's `id` and `slug` and `pageTypeSlug` are answered as that page's identity.
How a caller answers a naming being an identity is that caller's own.
The module saying a page's entries names nothing here.
An entry shape declaring no relation is answered as carrying no rows, so its rows are never read.

definition: the page a name reaches, and the edges the names in a page imply
